subtitle: Lesson 26 · Terraform in CI/CD

eyebrow: One line gates the whole job
code:
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  apply:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment: production

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: hashicorp/setup-terraform@v3
      - run: terraform init
      - run: terraform apply -auto-approve
caption: environment: production ties this job to a GitHub Environment's required-reviewer rule.
Configured once in Settings -> Environments; every future apply run inherits it.
